info.name: P2P · Service Management (/api/p2p/services)
info.description:
Service catalogue (Kryptone Service Master), organised like the screen: one folder per tab.

Run order: 0. Auth → 1. Master bundle (fills every id) → then any tab: List → Add (Stage 1) → Stage 2 & row actions.

Tabs (service_type → sub-type / classification):
• 2. Self-Consumable Services → trackable | consumable
• 3. Soft / Digital Services → no sub-type
• 4. Other Operational Services → professional | utility | facility | maintenance | outsourcing

GST: every service carries gst_id (GST % master, mandatory in Stage 1); domestic suppliers always use that same GST id.
Map Supplier: Domestic supplier (₹ price + service GST) or International supplier (price in its currency × exchange rate, no GST; ₹ equivalent in inr_amount).
NOTHING IS DELETED in this module: services, supplier mappings and service categories are switched Active / Inactive.
Service status: draft (Stage 1 saved) → active (Stage 2 submitted) ⇄ inactive.
Every request has a saved example response (Postman → Examples). Use Postman's Code (</>) → cURL to get the curl command.
Folders 5–7 and requests marked ♻ are existing APIs, listed in the order the screens use them.

request.description:
PUT /p2p/services/{id}/step/suppliers · the "Save & Submit" of Stage 2.
Full list of mapped suppliers: rows are created / updated, suppliers left out are switched INACTIVE (never deleted).
Fields per row: vendor_id (required, a supplier the user can see, no duplicates) · origin (domestic | international, optional — defaults to the supplier's country) · price (required, > 0)
  Domestic: GST is the service's GST (gst_id from Stage 1) — gst_id is optional and must equal it.
  International: currency (3-letter, default the supplier country's) · exchange_rate (₹ per unit, default the Currency master) · no GST.
  remarks (optional).
gst_amount, total_amount and inr_amount are always computed by the server. One bad row fails the whole submit (nothing saved). An empty list is allowed.
After submit: status = active, step_completed = 2.
